# omp-rpc-cli: the doc map for agents

## This repo

- [README.md](README.md): what the tool is, install, the command
  overview, safety model. The one starting point for a human.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the boundary, stated as rules an agent obeys.
- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): the numbered path from
  nothing to a running delegated session, every command copy-pasteable.
- [docs/how-to.md](docs/how-to.md): day-to-day operation, grouped by
  task: drive and review, monitor an unattended task, steer and abort,
  switch models live, presets, capture output, recover a wedged session.
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): the operator's reference: the
  command surface, the runtime files, the daemon wire protocol, every
  error string with its fix, recovery procedures.
- [docs/LEARNINGS.md](docs/LEARNINGS.md): design and protocol findings
  from wiring a client to omp's RPC (why RPC over ACP, the event
  framing, the selector rules, the gotchas).
- skills/using-omp-rpc/SKILL.md: the command mechanics as an agent
  skill (references/: commands, models, safety, architecture).
- skills/delegating-to-omp-rpc/SKILL.md: when and how to delegate to
  the session, as an agent skill.
- examples/session.sh: a scripted, runnable example session.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests, and the change bar.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting, scope.

## The family (AI ECP)

- the family catalog (the map home; in the private control-plane repo).
- repo-guards: governance kit (release parity, prose, CI gates; `guv`).
- actions-runner: config-driven local agent-pipeline runner (`arun`).
- ecp-toolkit: the `ecp` control-plane CLI that mounts the family
  (designed, not yet released).

## Facts

Version 0.3.0, npm `omp-rpc-cli`, Node >= 20, MIT. 14 platform-runner
tests pass (`npm test`). Verified 2026-10-22.
